leadText: Armen Mazlumian is a voice actor for the English dub of by TAJ Productions. From the second through fifth seasons, he acted as the sound supervisor/final mixer and an ADR engineer. He also acted as the voice director beginning with The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon, and during the ninth and tenth seasons, until the dubbing was taken over by DuArt Film & Video. He was succeeded in his roles by Tom Wayland.
